XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: STEERING COLUMN | STEERING | POWER STEERING | COMPLETE | MOTOR | CONTROL UNIT | B1053 | U0001 | U1700 | U1702 | ON | LIGHTS UP | LIGHTED | YELLOW | YELLOW | ABS | INDICATION | DISPLAY | SCREEN | HARD | TURNS | TURN |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Steering

  • Component: Steering column complete with electric motor and control unit

  • Fault: Occasional steering wheel stiffness accompanied by the power steering, ABS and engine warning lights coming on. ‘Fuel cut-off’ warning displayed on the screen

  • Errors detected by the self-diagnostic system: One or more of the following:
    • B1053 (Injection control unit, safety inertia switch control signal – Perform self-diagnosis)
    • U0001 (CAN bus – Fault)
    • U1700 (CAN data bus – Body computer – Fault, no communication)
    • U1702 (CAN data bus – Power steering control unit – Error, no communication)
  • Cause: Steering column, including electric motor and control unit, is malfunctioning

• Intervention: Proceed with the replacement of the steering column, including the related control unit and motor

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: The defective component did not show any visible abnormalities
